card.name: Inside drug names in interaction sections
card.fires_on: Partway through or at the end of a drug or drug class name in drug-interaction text, often just before the word describing the interaction (Concomitant, Potentiation). Examples are phenytoin, anticoagulants, corticosteroids, isoflurane.

modes.label: Mid-name piece
modes.description: A piece inside a longer drug name, with more of the name still to come.

modes.label: End of a drug or class name
modes.description: The last piece of an interacting drug or class heading, right before the interaction statement.

modes.label: List comma after drug examples
modes.description: A comma closing a list of example drugs or products in an interaction sentence.
